title: The Little Nash House - Minutes to Downtown
description:
Enjoy our renovated 1940's cottage only 3 miles to downtown, 5 miles to East, and 2 miles to 12 South. Our property is all about location and is roughly $15 uber anywhere in the city including the Airport! Enjoy our spacious backyard with a fully fenced in yard and patio with enough room for furry friends to run and play or host a dinner party with enough seats for 8 of your closest friends. Come stay with us and enjoy all that Nashville has to offer!

Permit #2022063283

The space
The space is a quaint 2 bed 1 bath home with plenty of yard space and easy access to all that Nashville has to offer

Guest access
The entire home and yard.
